releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v8.10.0 — Complete Top-to-Bottom UI Overhaul:
• 5 Streamlined Master Hubs in Sidebar: Consolidated 9 fragmented navigation tabs into 5 spacious, beautifully spaced Hubs (Dashboard, Gaming & GPU, Fans & Power, System Tools, Settings & Logs).
• Eradicated all UI overlaps: Standardized card geometry (166px height, 18px vertical progression) and dedicated zoning for status, rich explanations, and action buttons.
• Comprehensive Plain-English Explanations: Every single card now features clear, easy-to-understand explanations of what the feature does, the problem it solves, and the concrete FPS/battery benefit.
• Seamless Sub-Category Pill Navigation: Responsive viewports with zero endless vertical scrolling.
• OmniNeural v4 (18-Agent Autonomous Mesh) fully active for Gaming, Work, and Battery orchestration.
• Scrollable In-App Update Dialog with fixed bottom buttons.
